name: Heart of Mokk
summary: The Heart of Mokk is taken from Mokk the Savage in Cape of Stranglethorn. Fin Fizracket seeks it as a cure for Stranglethorn Fever.

sections.title: A Fever's Cure
sections.body: Fin Fizracket is stricken with a deadly fever in Booty Bay and believes only Mokk the Savage's heart can cure him. Witch Doctor Unbagwa, hidden in a cave on the southern cape, can summon the elusive white beast. The heart is what Fin needs to regain his strength.

faq.q: What is the Heart of Mokk?
faq.answer: The Heart of Mokk is the heart of Mokk the Savage, an elusive white beast in Cape of Stranglethorn.

faq.q: Who needs the Heart of Mokk?
faq.answer: Fin Fizracket in Booty Bay seeks the Heart of Mokk as a cure for Stranglethorn Fever.

faq.q: Where does the Heart of Mokk come from?
faq.answer: The Heart of Mokk comes from Mokk the Savage in Cape of Stranglethorn.
Witch Doctor Unbagwa, in a hidden cave on the southern cape, can summon Mokk the Savage.
